origine_fr: Il y a plus de 3 000 ans, c'était un fil noué aux deux bouts : la fin, aujourd'hui 终. Avec la glace, 冬 devient la dernière des quatre saisons. Le haut 夂 garde le fil noué, et les deux points ⺀ la glace.
origine_en: Over 3,000 years ago it was a cord knotted at both ends: the end, now written 终. Add ice and 冬 becomes the last of the four seasons. The top 夂 keeps the knotted cord, and the two dots ⺀ the ice.

mots.en: to spend the winter, to get through the winter

phrase.fr: Dans le Nord, l'hiver est long.
phrase.en: In the north, winter is long.
